title: Frontmatter of the vault's published Markdown files
description: Source of truth for MOD-vault's zod schemas. Unknown keys are allowed (Obsidian adds its own, such as tags and aliases) and ignored by the site. All fields are optional unless listed in 'required'.

title.description: Overrides the title derived from the file name (REQ-CNT-002)

description.description: Summary for cards and meta description (REQ-CNT-008)

draft.description: true keeps the file off the website (REQ-CNT-004). It stays visible on GitHub (CNF-003).

featured.description: Chapter: shown in Featured chapters. Article: pinned first in Latest articles

hero_image.description: File name of a diagram in the vault, e.g. 01-light.svg; its pair is used for dark mode

date.description: yyyy-mm-dd. Missing → published, undated, sorted last, with a warning (REQ-CNT-003.AC3)
